description: 地震時における地域別延焼危険度測定 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京消防庁. 【東京消防庁】東京都の地震時における地域別延焼危険度測定（第10回）のデータです。 詳細は下記ページよりご確認ください。 tfd. metro. tokyo. lg. jp/hp-bousaika/enshoukiken/index. html. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京消防庁. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 2 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
